hints.title: Array Value Precomputation
hints.text: Transform each input integer into its popcount depth by repeatedly counting set bits until reaching 1.

hints.title: Point Update Processing
hints.text: Recalculate the transformed depth upon point updates and refresh the array index.

hints.title: Range Occurrence Querying
hints.text: Count matches of target depth k across the queried index interval.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct array simulation supporting dynamic updates and range counts.
